_README: Known production findings that are ACCEPTED, so the nightly watchdog does not
fail on them every morning. They are still printed in the run log — this
suppresses the build failure, never the finding.
Why this exists: the LLM-key critical fired every night for a standing
configuration gap. A nightly alert that is red every night is not an alert,
it is wallpaper — and the moment something genuinely new breaks, nobody
looks. This keeps the red tick meaningful.
Every entry MUST have an `expires`. An acknowledgement with no end date is
how a real problem gets forgotten. On expiry the check goes red again and
you either fix it or consciously re-ack it.
`match` is a case-insensitive substring of the issue text.

acks.reason: Known and accepted: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / MOONSHOT_API_KEY are deliberately unset in production, so photo-to-quote, SOW drafting and the AI queue are dark. Tracked; the Play store listing deliberately claims no AI features because of it. Not an incident — a funding decision.
